blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 63 in June to 46 in October (−27.0%), and it took 13.8% of the city’s 247 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings fell from 15 in June to 13 in October (−13.3%), and it took 5.2% of the city’s 230 sales over the period.

The monthly write-ups singled out Silver Valley for detached houses in July (a sellers’ best bet); detached houses in October (a buyers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in June, July (a sellers’ best bet).

Lot character (sizes/zones), ONLY as the sources state them: Maple Ridge Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 — RS-1 subdivision minimums are 668.0 m² lot area, 18.0 m width and 27.0 m depth, with maximum lot coverage 40%. These are zone minimums, not a claim about any existing lot's size. Which zones apply to specific Silver Valley parcels: Not verified — check parcel by parcel.
ALR vs non-ALR split: no split is published and none is stated.

items.t: The page is headed "Silver Valley Homes for Sale, Maple Ridge," with editorial copy, a market/census snapshot block and a live feed whose visible cards are all labelled with the board sub-area "Silver Valley" (232 Street, 141 Avenue and Bryant Drive among the visible streets).

Identity: this page maps to the SnapStats board sub-area "Silver Valley" in the Maple Ridge community, and the City's neighbourhood list names Silver Valley — the City describes it as sitting on the north side of the Alouette River and as a gateway to recreation areas with trail networks. Street-level board boundary: Not verified — no public street-level boundary was opened, and no City neighbourhood boundary was substituted for it.

Market context at sub-area level, labelled as such and never a land figure: Silver Valley, September 2026 — Detached 49 / 5 / 10% (joint with Albion); Condos & Townhomes 15 / 0 / NA (no attached sale recorded that month). Maple Ridge community context (NOT Silver Valley's figures): Detached median $1,131,000; Condos & Townhomes median $525,000. SnapStats publishes medians at community level only, has NO land category, and publishes no Silver Valley median: Not verified at sub-area level, as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report.
Parks: Maple Ridge Park sits on the South Alouette River at 232 Street and 132 Avenue in Yennadon, with a playground, spray park and picnic shelter.

Transit: the West Coast Express stations serving Maple Ridge are Maple Meadows and Port Haney (weekday trains between Waterfront and Mission City) — both south-west of Silver Valley, not in it. Commute times in minutes: Not verified.
How people search for it: "Silver Valley Maple Ridge," "Silver Valley homes for sale," "homes for sale in Silver Valley BC."

faq.q: Can I buy a vacant building lot in Silver Valley?
faq.a: Lot-by-lot only — no named subdivision currently selling serviced vacant lots was verified. The built subdivisions trade as houses; the large-lot edge trades as individual acreage parcels whose designation, ALR status and servicing are confirmed per parcel.

faq.q: How did Silver Valley sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Medians are community-level only and are not Silver Valley's own.

faq.q: Did the Silver Valley Area Plan update change what my lot can become?
faq.a: The update was adopted November 25, 2025, and a feed card already markets an "Eco-Cluster Residential" designation in listing text — confirm the parcel's current designation and zone with the City before valuing subdivision or assembly potential; the listing wording is not the plan.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or more units to a Silver Valley lot?
faq.a: One secondary suite per lot inside the house, up to 40% of gross floor area and not in the floodplain area; eligible single-detached and duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws — verify the specific lot's eligibility before valuing suite income.

faq.q: Is a large Silver Valley lot in the ALR or the floodplain?
faq.a: Both are per-parcel checks — ALR status on the ALC mapping (a card's "not in ALR" line is listing text only), floodplain status on the City's Alouette/Fraser floodplain maps. Slope and watercourse permit requirements are checked the same way, by exact address.

faq.q: What plan governs Silver Valley now?
faq.a: Confirm a parcel's designation and zone with the City before relying on either.

faq.q: Can a Silver Valley house have a suite or more units?
faq.a: One secondary suite per lot inside the house (maximum 40% of gross floor area, not in the floodplain area), with SSMUH paths to three, four or six units on eligible lots — eligibility is a parcel-level check, and ALR parcels carry the ALC frame instead.

faq.q: A card showed a house with a basement suite — is that a duplex?
faq.a: No. A secondary suite inside a single-detached house is a suite, governed by Maple Ridge's 40%-of-gross-floor-area rule; a duplex is two dwelling units as the building's form.

faq.q: Can a duplex here also carry a suite or more units?
faq.a: One secondary suite inside the principal building, max 40% of gross floor area, not in the floodplain area; eligible single-detached and duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws — eligibility is a parcel-level check.

faq.q: How do I get downtown from Silver Valley?
faq.a: West Coast Express stations at Maple Meadows and Port Haney serve Maple Ridge on weekdays.
